properties.description: Conventional excavation required to replace 20’ of broken/shifted/offset and back pitched 5” terra-cotta main sewer line. To begin, we will obtain permit with local authority. Property owner/on site maintenance team responsible for removing fence for access to property for repairs as well as removal of plastic kids playground set. We will cut through Astroturf and dispose of collateral material. We will then excavate by machine up to 9’ deep to expose 20’ of 5” terra-cotta main sewer line which is separating and has become back pitched due to heavy erosion. Once terra-cotta has been removed between 4” cast-iron transition at rear of building and trap system, we will dispose of collateral materials. We will prep trench to receive new 4” cast-iron which we will reinstate to the cast-iron coming from building and then install new cast iron trap system. We will reinstate on street side of trap onto 5” terra-cotta by using ARC band as required by local authority. Upon reinstating, we will test for efficiency, then have inspected by local authority. Once given permission, we will bury back using same dirt. No dirt will be hauled away us do we recommend allowing 30-45 days for excavation site to settle prior to replacing surface materials. We do not perform finishing work, so Property owners/staff responsible for replacing Astroturf, fencing, and playset equipment. One full day required to replace sewer lateral. I could not camera through 5 inch terra-cotta trap due to depth out towards street so I cannot attest to the condition of the line beyond the trap. If that line continues to be back, pitched more work will be required at additional cost.

properties.description:
20 KW Kohler Installation
- Supply and install a Kohler 20 KW standby natural gas generator.  Generator to be located in rear of home between fence and air conditioning condenser. 
- Supply and install a pre-cast concrete pad for mounting of generator.
- Supply and install a Service Entrance rated, 200 amp Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS).
- Mount ATS in basement on adjacent wall from main panel. 
- Supply and install service cable from meter to ATS source 1 line-side taps.
- Re-feed main breaker panel with 150-amp sub-feeder.
- Rewire main breaker panel as a sub panel with grounds and neutrals separated.
- Supply all required grounding and bonding of service.
- Supply and install 100-amp sub-feeder from generator to ATS source 2 line-side taps.
- Supply a 15 amp, 120 volt house circuit for trickle charger and engine heater.
- Supply and install Belden communication cable from ATS to Generator.
- Supply and install Cat5e cable from the home network router/switch to the generator.
- Supply and install all necessary gas piping from gas meter, through basement soffit and out to rear of home. 
- Supply (1) low voltage relay for managing AC
- Supply (1) 50 Amp relay for managing large appliance.
- Configure the Kohler OnCue Plus monitoring system.
- Supply first year maintenance service, consisting of 2 visits, to provide manufacturer's required maintenance and other reliability testing. ($495 value)
- Kohler's 5-year limited warranty.

Panel Replacement
Replace 150-amp panel with 200-amp panel
- Shut down power at panel and remove meter.
- Remove service cable from main breaker panel.
- Remove main breaker panel.
- Supply and install a 200 amp, 30 space, main breaker load center.
- Reinstall service cable into new panel.
- Supply and install all required branch circuit breakers.
- Make all mains and branch circuit terminations.
- Identify circuits and place panel schedule.
- Re-install meter into socket, energize and test circuits.
NOTE:
